items.name: otp-field
items.title: OTP Field
items.description: One-time code entry on Base UI OTPField: Root, Input and Separator parts. Typing advances, Backspace steps back, paste fills all slots; numeric or alphanumeric validation. `status` prop (idle, verifying, success, error) with a reserved trailing cell; block caret in the active empty slot.
items.docs: Unofficial fan project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Square Enix or PlatinumGames. Built on Base UI; ornaments are drawn with CSS only. Migration (v4): each slot is now a span wrapper (the square) around the input plus a caret; Root takes `status`, which reserves one trailing cell so a status change never resizes the root. Slot 1 defaults to autoComplete="one-time-code", all slots inputMode="numeric". Error puts focus and selection on slot 1. The yorha caret is hidden when motion is off. Base UI still renders one extra hidden input for the form value.
